title: Domio Model Asset V1
description: 3D model asset metadata for Phase 11. Tracks uploaded models (glTF/GLB/USDZ/CAD), derived renditions, polygon budgets, and license provenance.

schemaVersion.description: Semver of the model asset schema.

format.description: Original file format of the uploaded model.

sourceUrl.description: CDN URL of the original uploaded file.

derivedUrl.description: CDN URL of the optimized glTF 2.0 binary (GLB) rendition.

thumbnailUrl.description: CDN URL of a preview thumbnail.

polyCount.description: Triangle count of the derived model.

textureCount.description: Number of textures in the derived model.

hasAnimations.description: Whether the model contains skeletal or morph-target animations.

cadSourceUrl.description: CDN URL of the original CAD file (STEP/FBX), kept for traceability.

licenseId.description: Reference to the license governing this asset.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata (LOD levels, up_axis, polygon budget tier, etc.).
